$comment: What the installer carries outside the crate and npm package graphs, for scripts/third-party-notices.ps1. Each entry was checked against the version in `tiedTo`; once the tree resolves another, the gate fails until the entry is checked again (see README.md). `markers` name the helper signatures (notices-lib.ps1) the built interface must show for the entry, and `texts` the folder here holding its license texts.

components.name: Vite runtime helpers (preload helper, __vite__mapDeps)
components.note: Emitted by Vite into the built interface: code for loading its chunks, not the build tool itself.

components.name: Module preload polyfill (Rolldown's, for Vite; adapted from es-module-shims)
components.note: Emitted by Rolldown, Vite's bundler, into the built interface. It is the polyfill Vite carried until 7, whose source gave Guy Bedford's notice for it; Rolldown's license, beside it, covers the port.

components.name: Rolldown runtime helpers (CommonJS interop, module namespaces)
components.note: Emitted by Rolldown, Vite's bundler, into the built interface for the CommonJS packages it bundles (React among them). Derived from esbuild's runtime: Rolldown's THIRD-PARTY-LICENSE, with esbuild's and Rollup's notices, goes with its own.

components.name: NSIS (the installer's stub, its LZMA decompressor and the NSISdl plug-in)
components.source: https://github.com/kichik/nsis/tree/v311 (Debian trixie's nsis package, in docker/windows-build.Dockerfile)
components.note: setup.exe is built with NSIS and carries its runtime code; the zlib/libpng license covers NSIS itself and the Common Public License its LZMA module, as COPYING says.

components.name: Tauri's NSIS installer template (adapted in src-tauri/windows/installer.nsi)
components.note: The installer script, compiled into setup.exe: build-windows.ps1 makes setup.exe from installer.nsi, which reproduces parts of the template with changes (its header lists them).

components.name: Cascadia Mono (Regular and Bold, static TrueType)
components.note: The native window's one font, compiled into luna.exe unmodified (src-tauri/crates/window/assets/fonts, its font.rs). The Reserved Font Name is Cascadia Code.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime (vcruntime, static library)
components.license: Microsoft Visual Studio license terms, Distributable Code
components.note: Linked statically into luna.exe (static_vcruntime, from the crate's build script); the Universal CRT it links dynamically is part of Windows. The runtime libraries are Distributable Code under the Visual Studio license terms (https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/license-terms/; the list at https://learn.microsoft.com/visualstudio/releases/2022/redistribution), distributed here on the conditions those terms set.
components.noText: Microsoft publishes the terms, not a license text to reproduce; they are linked above.
